newsitem.title: EGYPT: Six people dead after floods in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Six people dead after floods in Egypt.

text.p: Six people died and houses were washed away after heavy rains pummelled southern Egypt provinces and parts of Sinai, officials said on Monday.
"Four people of the same family were electrocuted and a ten-year-old girl was killed when a palm tree fell on her," said Assiut province secretary Fouad Khalil.
A woman in Sohag province, 400 km (250 miles) south of Cairo, was killed in flooding after the rains, which started on Sunday and ended early on Monday, officials said.
"Nine villages and 1,400 feddans (566 hectares) were submerged in the province under 60 centimetres (23.6 inches) of water," Khalil added.
Airports in popular tourist areas of Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurgada closed briefly but have reopened, state television said.
Rami Mostafa, reservation manager at the Hilton in Sharm, said some hotels closed temporarily and telephone and electricity lines were cut.
